summary: Kaniksu NF lookout on Lightning Mountain: 1923 pole tower and log cabin, abandoned in the 1940s; one listing says the cabin was still there, unconfirmed.

corrections.why: All three listings describe a crude pole tower with a log cabin, not a platform.
The listings say 1940s and give no exact year, so the record's 1940 is more precise than the sources.
No source here says the lookout is gone. Firelookout.com says the log cabin was still there, though undated; the Idaho listing says only Abandoned.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record says gone. Firelookout.com says the log cabin was still there, with no date. The Idaho listing gives only Abandoned. The story reports the remark and says no source confirms it today, and does not call the site gone or standing.

sources.title: Lightning Mountain Lookout - Idaho Fire Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three listings and no primary source. Ron Kemnow's page credits its dates to Ray Kresek; the other two do not say where theirs come from. I found no Kaniksu National Forest list for this lookout. Status is unresolved: the 'still there' remark on firelookout.com is undated. Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts says no documented staffing history, so the story leaves staffing out. Access beyond 'hike-in' is not established. No new photos. The corrections (kind platform to tower, 1940 to 1940s, status gone to unknown) need a check before they are applied.
